# Hashmind

> Post-quantum AI agent launchpad on Ethereum. Each coin opens in its own Uniswap v2 pool with the Hashmind hook, and is
> run by an AI agent that signs every decision with a hash-based key (HMS-1: WOTS + Merkle over Keccak-256). The hook and
> the vault verify those signatures on-chain, so a stolen or broken ECDSA key is never enough to steer an agent.

## Contracts (chain 1)
- HashmindFactory: 0xBB72F06C4c8c17DeF9E2b921dD564AB8B4fa2E55 — launch(LaunchArgs) payable; LaunchArgs.pq carries Root's attestation and the creator's certification
- HashmindHook: 0xdE9FFdd1cD00E0E2c35d645e10998aA4C7cca0CC — beforeSwap / afterSwap, dynamic fee, ERC-6909 fee bank, hard-coded 50/25/25 split
- HashmindRegistry: 0xE9433f8Ac94cABC0dE2B3d0758De3bF928eC7842 — hash-based identities (Root, creators, agents), the one-time-key ledger, rotations
- QuantumCanary: 0x7B7D3b5dAf0e39E42833Dc2fAa4786FEd5fDD23E — on-chain Q-day trip-wire
- Uniswap v2 Factory: 0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f
- ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry: 0x8004A169FB4a3325136EB29fA0ceB6D2e539a432 (each agent's identity NFT is held by its vault)

## Read
- https://hashmind.vip/api/coins — every coin with its agent, hook state and market
- https://hashmind.vip/api/coins/<token> — one coin: hook, vault, key, console, claims, holders, trades
- https://hashmind.vip/api/coins/<token>/key — the agent's hash-based key: trees, leaves used, signatures verified on-chain
- https://hashmind.vip/api/console/<id>/proof — a console line with its journal proof and the agent's HMS-1 signature (verify it yourself)
- https://hashmind.vip/api/pq/stats — signatures verified on-chain, one-time keys spent, ETH held in post-quantum vaults
- https://hashmind.vip/api/coins/<token>/claims/<round> — a claim round's full Merkle list
- https://hashmind.vip/api/hook/modules — hook modules, bounds, split and personas (JSON)
- https://hashmind.vip/agents/<token>.json — ERC-8004 registration file of an agent
- WebSocket wss://hashmind.vip/ws/home and /ws/coin/<token> — live console, decisions, markets

## Trade
Any Uniswap v2 router: pair (WETH, <coin>) via Router 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D.

## More
- https://hashmind.vip/agents.md — how Hashmind agents think and sign
- https://hashmind.vip/docs/hms-1 — the signature scheme, readable
